excludedPullRequests.1240: reserved for an external owner (fix/task-board-accessibility-1239); not read or measured here
excludedPullRequests.1242: dependency update (renovate), not an M18 readiness leaf
excludedPullRequests.1246: merged into main (34a3eaad); measured as part of main, not as a candidate

metric-identifiers.description: Identifiers for the REQ 153 instrumentation list (admission latency, human-message wait, queue depth, stuck tasks, reconciliation age, duplicate suppression, model usage, storage growth), searched in product source only. Identifier presence does not prove the metric is emitted.

budget-reservation.description: Transactional budget reservation or settlement identifiers (REQ 150-151).

operator-controls.description: Operator intervention identifiers: stop admissions, fence attempts, revoke grants, reconcile (REQ 154).

feature-flags.description: Feature-flag or profile and backend admission routing identifiers in product source (TDD section 18 rollout sequence).

rollback-code.description: Rollback routing or cohort identifiers in product source (REQ 175-176). Generic transaction rollback is excluded by the pattern.

retention-gate.description: Trusted cleanup gate identifiers in product source (REQ 045, A35).

redaction-tests.description: Test files that exercise redaction of secrets or private payloads (REQ 152).

reduced-motion-tests.description: Test files that emulate reduced motion (REQ 136).

model-call-guard-tests.description: Test files that assert no provider or model call happens on a path (REQ 005, A10, A12).
model-call-guard-tests.pattern: Unexpected provider call|Unexpected model|model calls|without catalog or model

langgraph-references.description: LangGraph references that must leave the target architecture (TDD section 17). A count of references, not a percentage claim.

rollout-runbooks.description: Rollout or rollback runbook documents under docs/ (issue #1224 acceptance 2).

criteria.source: TDD section 20, A25; PRD REQ 136; TDD Measurable success criteria (Accessibility)
criteria.criterion: Changed flows meet the recorded accessibility acceptance scope for keyboard, screen reader, zoom and reduced motion; release-blocking accessibility defects are zero.
criteria.threshold: zero serious or critical axe findings on the scanned surfaces (strict audit contract)

method.scope: chat workspace, Dev View, narrow Dev View, Settings tabs (existing M12 audit surfaces)
method.limit: Pi Durable changed flows (Agents directory, Conversations inbox, group creation, job approval and cancel) are not on main and are not scanned here

criteria.source: PRD REQ 135; TDD section 20, A25
criteria.criterion: Keyboard users can reach primary surfaces, operate controls, return focus after dialogs, and receive accessible status announcements.
criteria.threshold: existing keyboard and focus certification passes

criteria.source: PRD REQ 136 (text zoom, reduced motion, contrast, keyboard traversal, screen-reader order)
criteria.criterion: Text zoom, reduced motion, contrast, keyboard traversal and screen-reader order are tested on changed flows.
criteria.threshold: tests exist for each named check on main

criteria.source: PRD REQ 136
criteria.criterion: Color is never the sole status indicator.

method.reason: No automated rule checks color-only status. Needs rendered-state review of each status surface.

criteria.source: PRD REQ 136 (contrast); appearance presets and canonical editor roles
criteria.criterion: Interaction and text contrast meet WCAG thresholds for appearance presets and canonical theme editor roles.
criteria.threshold: primary vs background >= 3:1; onPrimary vs strong >= 4.5:1; editor roles >= 4.5:1

method.limit: covers presets and editor roles only; does not scan every rendered text pair

criteria.source: M12 #541 manual certification (docs/evidence/m12-541-manual-a11y-certification-2026-10-06.md, residuals)
criteria.criterion: Human-operated screen-reader pass (VoiceOver, NVDA or Orca) on required flows.

method.reason: Requires a person operating a screen reader on the target build. An agent cannot produce this evidence.

criteria.source: PRD REQ 135-136; TDD section 20, A25
criteria.criterion: Pi Durable changed flows (Agents directory, Conversations inbox, group creation, job approval and cancel) pass keyboard and AT checks.
criteria.threshold: zero release-blocking defects on those flows

method.reason: Those flows are not on main; they exist only on open candidate branches owned by their child issues. Not scanned in this PR.

criteria.source: scripts/client-bundle-budgets.mjs CLIENT_BUNDLE_BUDGETS.total (code is newer than ADR-0010's table)
criteria.criterion: All emitted client JavaScript stays within the aggregate raw, gzip and file-count ceilings.

method.command: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/web start:check-bundle

criteria.source: CLIENT_BUNDLE_BUDGETS.startup; ADR-0010 gate 1 (startup graph)
criteria.criterion: The workspace startup static graph stays within its ceiling.

method.command: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/web start:check-bundle

criteria.source: CLIENT_BUNDLE_BUDGETS.views (incremental per route); ADR-0010 gate 1
criteria.criterion: Each lazy route stays within its own incremental ceiling, so growth is attributed to its owner.
criteria.threshold: per-route raw and gzip ceilings in CLIENT_BUNDLE_BUDGETS.views

method.command: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/web start:check-bundle

criteria.source: ADR-0010 web budgets table: local TTFB p50, LCP, CLS, interaction proxy (scripts/measure-web-performance.mjs)
criteria.criterion: Local TTFB p50 <= 300 ms; LCP <= 4,000 ms; CLS <= 0.15; worst scripted interaction (INP proxy) <= 500 ms.

method.reason: Needs a built Cloudflare Worker and the pinned Chromium run. Not executed in this PR; the last recorded baseline is 2026-09-23 (docs/evidence/m15-301-perf-baseline-2026-09-23.md).

criteria.source: ADR-0010 gate 2 (a full rebuild is the cost unit)
criteria.criterion: Build cost is measured as a full rebuild, never a cache hit. ADR-0010 cites a 7 s rebuild.

criteria.source: TDD Measurable success criteria (Responsiveness); PRD section 21 'Performance targets and capacity' (approval pending)
criteria.criterion: Durable message or job admission p95 <= 1 s; scheduling an eligible new human turn p95 <= 2 s under the agreed representative load, excluding provider generation time.
criteria.threshold: proposed; FOUNDATIONS approval of load and thresholds pending

method.reason: Thresholds are proposed and unapproved, the representative load is undefined, and no admission benchmark exists on main. Measuring a lab build would not establish the target.

criteria.source: ADR-0010 'Enforced by' column (Dev Runtime budgets in docs/specs/dev-runtime.md)
criteria.criterion: Dev Runtime budgets: chat and dev graph purity, terminal input-to-paint, 1,000-row virtualization.
criteria.threshold: as stated in the dev-runtime spec

method.reason: Not executed in this PR; requires the dev-runtime harness.

criteria.source: ADR-0010 desktop row (artifact size and idle RSS are the comparable numbers)
criteria.criterion: Desktop shell artifact size and idle RSS are recorded for the candidate.
criteria.threshold: recorded, no enforced limit in ADR-0010

method.reason: Requires a packaged desktop build (Electrobun, bundled CEF) on the release host. Not produced in this PR.

criteria.source: PRD REQ 005; TDD A10, A12; TDD Measurable success criteria (Direct-path independence)
criteria.criterion: No model run is required to create a workspace, browse status, reconnect, open a transcript, change a view or start a direct session. Verified by traces: zero lead-model invocations on those paths.
criteria.threshold: zero lead-model invocations on the listed paths

method.limit: covers the structural-lead setup path only. Workspace creation, browse, reconnect, transcript open and direct-session start have no zero-call test on main (manifest gap for REQ-005).

criteria.source: TDD A34, A39, A40; PRD REQ 051, 059
criteria.criterion: Setup is blocked before inference when a model, connection, funding or quota is not eligible; no silent provider or account fallback.

method.reason: Eligibility and picker behavior are in open candidate branches (for example PR #1238 and #1229), not on main.

criteria.source: TDD section 16, REQ 150 (transactional reservation; per-request enforcement before any hard-limit claim)
criteria.criterion: Admission reserves budget transactionally and binds it to job, attempt and workspace.

criteria.source: TDD section 16, REQ 151 (estimate, reserved, reported, reconciled and settled cost kept distinct)
criteria.criterion: Cost states are differentiated and unknown cost is shown as unknown.

criteria.source: TDD section 16, REQ 155; PRD section 21 'Performance targets and capacity'
criteria.criterion: Active-object time, storage writes and size, and optional service consumption are measured under representative workloads.

method.reason: No representative workload exists and no metering data is accessible from this repository or session.

criteria.source: TDD section 17 (provider cost, Agent HQ credits and native subscription usage kept separate); TDD section 16 REQ 151
criteria.criterion: Provider invoices and infrastructure bills are reconciled to product usage for the rollout window.

method.reason: Requires billing exports from Cloudflare, Neon, Railway and model providers for the rollout window. None are accessible to this repository or session. No cost is estimated or inferred here.

criteria.source: TDD Measurable success criteria (Simplification); TDD section 17 REQ 155 business case
criteria.criterion: Removed packages, service roots and deployment steps are recorded against the pre-migration inventory. No percentage cost claim without measurement.

criteria.source: TDD section 20 Measurable success criteria; TDD section 16 REQ 150
criteria.criterion: Hard spend-limit claims are made only after per-request enforcement covers model retries, compaction, summaries, cache refresh and ambiguous requests.

method.reason: Per-request enforcement is absent on main (COST-03 probe), so no hard spend limit is claimed.

criteria.source: TDD section 16, REQ 152 (correlated IDs; logs exclude secrets and private payloads)
criteria.criterion: Correlated IDs are recorded and default logs exclude secrets and private payloads.

criteria.source: TDD section 16, REQ 153; TDD section 18 Metrics
criteria.criterion: Admission latency, human-message wait, first response, queue depth, child concurrency, retries, stuck tasks, unacknowledged events, approval age, reconciliation age, duplicate suppression, model usage and storage growth are instrumented.

criteria.source: TDD section 16, REQ 154 (stop admissions, inspect stuck jobs, revoke grants, fence attempts, reconcile)
criteria.criterion: Operator controls exist, are attributed and audited.

criteria.source: TDD section 18 Rollout sequence (feature flags and profile/backend admission routing)
criteria.criterion: Rollout uses feature flags and profile or backend admission routing for each cohort stage.

criteria.source: TDD section 18 Rollback, REQ 175 (route new admissions back; retain compatible readers)
criteria.criterion: Before a cohort is enabled, routing new admissions back to the previous supported path is tested, with new runtime state exportable.
criteria.threshold: rollback routing tested for each cohort

criteria.source: TDD section 18, REQ 176; TDD section 20, A31 (rollback with active new and old work, uncertain effects)
criteria.criterion: One fenced owner per attempt; uncertain effects are reconciled before resume or restart.

method.reason: Fencing and rollback rehearsal are on open candidate branches (issues #1220 and #1222), not on main.

criteria.source: TDD section 18, REQ 170 and 174 (before and after comparison by IDs, counts, digests and audiences)
criteria.criterion: A migration report compares before and after IDs, counts, digests and audiences, and includes negative tests.

method.limit: Runs the comparator unit tests only. Per-store migration reports are not exercised by this measurement.

criteria.source: PRD REQ 045; TDD section 20, A35 (permanent deletion gated on trusted cleanup)
criteria.criterion: Permanent deletion fails closed until trusted cleanup verifies every required store.
criteria.threshold: A35 test passes on both human and lead paths

criteria.source: TDD section 20, A27, A36 (portable authorized export; residency)
criteria.criterion: Authorized portable export and residency checks pass without credentials or private-audience leakage.

criteria.source: Issue #1224 acceptance 2 (canonical Docs and operator guidance, rollout, rollback)
criteria.criterion: Canonical Docs and operator guidance for rollout and rollback exist and their links resolve.
criteria.threshold: runbook documents present; docs boundary check passes

criteria.source: Issue #1224 acceptance 1 (required owner daily-driver evidence); TDD section 20 (owner daily-driver journeys)
criteria.criterion: Required owner daily-driver journeys are completed and recorded.

method.reason: Requires the owner to use the candidate. No agent can produce this evidence.

criteria.source: TDD section 20 (exact compatible packaged and deployed candidates); PRD section 21 release evidence
criteria.criterion: Packaged and deployed candidate evidence for the exact head.

method.reason: No packaging, deployment or release is authorized for this leaf. Root decides whether to request one.

criteria.source: PRD section 21 'Retention and recovery objectives' (decision pending); TDD Measurable success criteria (Recovery SLOs)
criteria.criterion: Per-data-class retention periods and per-profile RPO and RTO are chosen; detection and recovery SLOs are set from profile tests before default rollout.

method.reason: The objectives are not decided. No production data exists to set them.

criteria.source: TDD section 18 Rollout sequence (cohort composition and observation window)
criteria.criterion: Canary and cohort observation windows are chosen and observed on production traffic.

method.reason: No production traffic or cohort is available to this repository or session. The cohort is chosen during implementation per the TDD.

criteria.source: Issue #1224 scope ('disclose unresolved gates'; 'no full-readiness certification')
criteria.criterion: Full release readiness is certified.
criteria.threshold: none; this leaf does not certify readiness

method.reason: Unresolved gates above (ACC-06, ACC-07, COST-05, COST-06, OPS-06, OPS-11 to OPS-14) prevent any readiness claim.
